title: Wisdom Is to Avoid What Does Not Concern You
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allah Allah. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Madad yaa RijaalAllah. La ilaaha
illa-Llah, La ilaaha illa-Llah, La ilaaha illa-Llah, La ilaaha illa-Llah, La ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadur
Rasoolullah `alayhi salaatullah. Dastoor. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
We are giving our salute to all holy ones and asking for support. Allah Almighty may load on an ant this
whole world. no doubt. (We are asking from one of the holy ones to look after our humble meeting. It is a
humble meeting, but it is such a nuclear bomb! When they are opening this power from the east to the west,
it may destroy everything under the title of baatil, falsehood. And we are giving salaat wa 's-salaam also to all
holy ones on this planet and particularly to that one who is carrying the responsibility for everything in this
world!
Man is making an instrument (points to cameras), which is reaching millions of centers. Man has been
created weak. But what about those who are related to the heavenly center; what are they able to do? They
may take all the oceans, if they are saying, "Get up over this world and keep yourself there until I am ordering
you!" One wali, yet all oceans are coming up, as that one has powers that no one can think about.
They are thinking that Mankind, they are easy ones. No! The Lord of Heavens has granted them the title to be

deputies, such a majestic order from Allah Almighty to weak servants. They may say, “All you oceans, stand
up!” and you won't even find one drop remaining in the oceans. They are making me speak on such things to
give new understandings to Man. We can't speak on heavenly, Divinely Existence, no, but they are beginning
from Mankind who have been granted, Shaykh Hisham Effendi, to speak on the level of understanding of
Mankind. They can’t get up, no. Therefore, those who are attending must try to bring all their attention and
try to give their utmost care towards understanding something. Allahu Akbar! (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allahu Akbaru 'l-Akbar. While we are standing up and sitting down, billions of new creations are coming,
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) in saahatu 'l-wujood (plane of existence). Yes, they keep coming. Allahu Akbar. Assalaamu `alayk, yaa Sultan al-Awliyaa! Nahnu nasa'l … a very small support for people on this planet, whose
efforts are only for this planet, those who are trying to reach under the oceans or over the skies.
A grasshopper is jumping; it is asking to reach up, but it is reaching a distance, then it is coming down. Now
people are on the same way, looking up and saying, "We can reach.” To where can you reach? Is this dunya a
small place for you? Is it not enough? Why are you trying to jump up and up? With some material powers you
can't reach even one kilometer or two kilometers, then you are coming down.
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum, everyone from Mankind! Give a second, and it may be in that second
you might find an interest for something. It may be you are asking to hark yarmak, to make two pieces. They
are asking in a very short time to make this distance go up, but it is not as they are thinking. We are here and
everything is in limits. We have been granted for our physical being some possibilities, but people are trying
to reach impossible aspects. This material being is never suitable. Therefore, they are throwing up some
rockets and it is not their field. Therefore they are going till some distance, then either they are dying in it or
that rocket is exploding and nothing is remaining there. This is because Mankind is not thinking that distance
can’t be reached with our material possibilities. They are majnoon people, crazy ones. And Shaytan's first
mission is to cheat people and make them run after the impossible.
Now through the east and the west, everywhere people are trying to reach impossible aspects! Balaa'un
`azham, “biggest affliction,” running after the impossible, when Mankind's area is within a very short
distance, a very limited area. But day and night, Shaytan is making people occupy themselves with unreality,
to make them work on, maa laa ya`neeh, not of their concern. They are trying for something that is
impossible. Leave that! Why are you asking to reach up and up and up? What is that? It is not your field! But

Shaytan's whole effort is to make people yushghilahum `ani 'l-haqeeqah. Shaytan is asking people not to try
for something that is for them, but to be occupied with nonsense. And now, all the people in the world are
under the title of "technology," and their aim is to reach the impossible. All efforts they are expanding for
nonsense. For example, I am saying leave running after Venus or Jupiter or Mars, or after our Solar System;
leave that and look! If one mosquito is coming on you and biting you, catch it or take your revenge from it,
punish it! Doing both is impossible, either this or that. But Shaytan's first aim is to make people run after a
direction that is impossible for them to reach.
Shaytan's famous struggle is to make people's ways, their mentalities and their efforts, to go in the wrong
direction. Wrong direction! They are deeply trying to get an understanding of an atom. They can't understand
it; only through their high mathematical knowledge, they might reach something. They are not knowing that
all the knowledge they are learning is taking them to the Lord of the Heavens. They are looking at an atom,
occupying themselves around the atoms, but they are not thinking that every knowledge is going to take
people to their Lord's Heavenly Presence! Shaytan's mission is cheating people by occupying them with
nonsense!
O our Salafi `ulamas! As-salaamu alaykum. You are not here? Why? Is there an invitation tonight or some
important meeting? I don’t know.Where are you? Say! Why are you not saying hadith an-nabawiyyatu 'shshareef? (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Saying the Seal of Prophets:
•• ••• ••••• ••••• ••• •• •• •••••
min husna Islam al-marra tarkuhu maa laa ya`neeh, “From the perfection of a man's Islam is to leave what
does not concern him.”
Is it correct?You are never seeing that hadith ash-shareef? (Mawlana Shaykh sits) A meaning on the first
understanding of that hadith ash-shareef, the Seal of Prophets(s) is saying, "O People! You must understand
min husna islam al-marra tarkuhu maa laa ya`neeh."
O Salaafu s-Saaliheen `ulama! Marhaban. Are you ever understanding the meaning of that hadith ashshareef ? That is just ulhim `alaa qalbee, (inspired to my heart) that is just waarid, (inspiration) coming to
my heart to say to you, doctors of Shari`ah and to Azhari ash-shareef `ulamas. This is a big ocean! Hisham
Effendi, first of all, those mutakabireen, “arrogant ones and oppressors,” Salaafu s-Salih `ulamas never speak

on it! And that hadith ash-shareef of the Seal of Prophets (s) is enough to change the whole Islamic world
from baatil to haqq and to make for them hayyatun tayyibah, “a good life.” If we are using and practicing, and
understanding the meaning of that hadith ash-shareef, the whole nation of the Seal of Prophets (s) will be like
the stars in the skies! That hadith ash-shareef was just taught from Whom? From Allah Almighty! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands)
••••••••••• ••••••• •••••••••• •••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••
Al-rahmaan. `Allama 'l-quraan. Khalaqa 'l-insaan. `Allamaahu 'l-bayaan.
(God) Most Gracious! It is He Who has taught the Qur'an. He has created Man. He has taught him speech
(and intelligence). (Ar-Rahman 55:1-4)
Sometimes I remember, sometimes. Because I am very angry with Salafi 'ulamas! (Mawlana Shaykh sits).

SubhaanAllah! O jalaalatu 'l-mulook, you must call your jalsa, royal court, from time to time and you must
try them for something. This is one hadith ash-shareef that may save not only the Islamic world, but may
save all humanity, all of nature, it may save all creatures and the life of everything on this planet! Only one
hadith! O Salaaf as-Salih `ulamas, maa ma`na, what is the meaning that the Seal of Prophet's saying: ••••
••••• ••••• uteetoo jawami` u 'l-kalim? "I was given the most comprehensive of words." Say! Yes. Allahu
Akbar. The Seal of Prophets' declarations and his hadith ash-shareef, even one of them is enough to save all
nations!
This hadith is, ajaa`ib “very amazing.” Tashreen, “dissect it.” If you are dissecting, then you must look what is
in it. min husna islam al-marra tarkuhu maa laa ya`neeh. According to our teachers’ teaching, because our
level is not such a level to say that we are taking from the Seal of Prophets (s) No, our level is very much
down; on the last level we may understand something. But it is enough to save nations, particularly to save
the Muslim world! I have been granted now to speak on the collective efforts of all people in the world. They
are doing this and that, over the seas, under the seas, over the clouds, in forests, in deserts, we are making
efforts; everyone is trying to do something. But mostly, people are not using a scale of the Heavens that has
only been granted to selected, special, honored ones. I am asking you, doctors of shari'ah, to make an
understanding of that hadith, and send to me through that instrument, whether I am wrong or on the right
way. That is showing who is mu'min. And behind them are all nations, all of Mankind, whose efforts are in
two directions. One direction is maa ya`neeh; the second is, maa laa ya`neeh. True?

Haqeeqat, “reality;” that gives the meaning, but it is such a big ocean saving all humanity! Heavenly
teachings through the Seal of Prophets (s) are ordering him to speak to his nation, and all nations now belong
to him, but they are not running to understand who he is. The Lord of Heavens is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh
stands)
••••• ••••••• •••• ••••••••
wa maa yantiqu `ani al-hawa'.
Nor does he say anything of (his own) desire. (53:3)
Who is that one? (Mawlana sits) Why are you not saying? And so many foolish ones are trying to refuse the
declarations of the Seal of Prophets (s)! I am sending those to be waiters of WC. That is good for them, those
who are asking to refuse the Seal of Prophets' declarations! And one day they will be put down in those
sewage channels! Their graves are going to be on those sewage channels.
I heard that in Egypt there was one person, so famous he was changing everything. But not according to the
Holy Qur'an or holy hadiths of Rasoolullah (s). He was buried in such a place that when they were looking
after one day, they found that his body was sailing on sewage channels like a boat in the sea. They took that
one's body to another place, buried it there, but still they were finding the same thing. Then they were saying,
“We can't do anything; this is not from ourselves, but it is from the Lord of Heavens making it for that one."
He who was against Islam and against the principles of Islam, who followed the principles of jabaabirah,
“tyrants,” that was his punishment! If you are taking his body to the desert, you will find the same sewage
channels there.
Fear God! Those people who are not fearing from Allah (swt) are first-class troublemakers! They are leaving
the Holy Qur'an, taking so many baatil rules, saying, “We are this, we are that.” We are not democrats! We
are followers of Shari`atullah! There is no democracy in the Holy Qur'an! Whoever is saying that are foolish
and idiotic ones, and those who never understand! Allah Almighty will punish them as He punished that one!
Look for the understanding of what Rasoolullah (s) was saying.
That means there are two kinds of efforts in front of a mu'min. One of them is maa ya`neeh, “what concerns
us.” Second is maa laa ya`neeh, “what doesn't concern us.” And we have been ordered to look after maa
ya`neeh, concerning ourselves for the benefit of Mankind, but not to use our efforts for something that is maa

laa ya`neeh, that which is never for Mankind to look after. And all nations are on maa laa ya`neeh.
Everywhere they are running from maa ya`neeh, that from holy commands we have been ordered to keep it,
maa ya`neeh. But people and believers are now running after maa laa ya`neeh. Shaykh Hisham Effendi, may
Allah forgive us! And He can only change what we are in. I am sorry to say this, and I am trying to open an
unopened or a closed door for our Salafi `ulamas, to say about this hadith ash-shareef. They may speak on it
from the beginning of Islam up to Yawmul Qiyamah, “The Day of Judgment,” but they will never finish!
May Allah forgive us. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah, astaghfirullah.
Fatihah.
Hisham Effendi, it is a very important point that may change the whole world! Astaghfirullah.
(48 minutes)
Alhamdulillah. Alhamdulillah. Yaa Rabbee, shukr. Yaa Rabbee, shukr. Alhamdulillah, yaa Rabbee.
